edits.value_json: "The bright moving shadows sprang across the gate, and Pip fluttered behind it. Ada’s dragon froze mid-sneeze. Bo left the ribbon quiet and visible, a little silver path waiting in the moonlight."
"Behind the gate, one feeler peeked toward the quiet ribbon. Ada’s dragon stayed frozen mid-sneeze, while the little silver path gleamed on, ready for a gentler hello."
